task_description: Make Coinscribed feel like a fully-operational real news website by adding deterministic dummy images throughout (homepage, news listing, category pages, article detail, author avatars) and new editorial sections (homepage Trending/Most-Read, Explore by Topic, Editor's Picks; news listing lead story; article detail hero + byline + Related Articles; a new About page; enriched Footer). All work must respect the existing Ink & Oxblood design language and keep build + lint green.
